units.source_text: 我仿佛觉得这是个非常好的主意，生命保险这种东西就浮现在我脑海里。

en.t: It somehow seemed to me like a very good idea, and the notion of life insurance came into my mind.

units.source_text: 然而，还是个年轻学生的身份，竟认真地思考这种事，

en.t: And yet, being still a young student, to think seriously about such a thing

units.source_text: 自己不免感到很不光彩。

en.t: made me feel rather ashamed of myself.
